# Chainlink Local Documentation

> Product-level navigation index for Chainlink Local documentation.

Prefer specific `.md` pages. Do not rely on memorized version differences, registered chains, or dependency pins.

Match the API reference version to the installed `@chainlink/local` package before reading contract details.

## Overview and Concepts

- [Overview](https://docs.chain.link/chainlink-local.md)
- [Architecture](https://docs.chain.link/chainlink-local/learn/architecture.md)

- [CCIP starter kit examples map](https://docs.chain.link/chainlink-local/learn/starter-kit-examples.md)
- [Contributing](https://docs.chain.link/chainlink-local/learn/contributing.md)
